note: The OLG covers property insurance verification as part of shelter expense verification. The 'Shelter Expenses Deduction' page (Allowable Shelter Expenses section) explicitly lists homeowner's insurance as a countable shelter expense within the mortgage components (principal, interest, homeowner's insurance, real estate taxes). The 'Verification of Shelter Expenses' section on the same page lists acceptable verifications including 'current homeowner's insurance declaration page' and the catch-all 'any document that verifies the allowable expenses described above.' While FNS 1153.2 specifically enumerates three document types (bills, statements, and policies from the insurance company), the OLG's verification list—which includes the insurance declaration page plus the open-ended 'any document' provision—functionally covers the same ground. A worker reading the OLG would know that homeowner's insurance is a shelter expense and that it requires verification via insurance documentation.
